info.title: rupta API
info.description: Management and query API of rupta. Authenticate with the `rupta_session` cookie plus the `X-CSRF-Token` header on mutating requests, or with `Authorization: Bearer rpt_...`. See docs/api.md.

get.summary: Downloads an attachment (always as a file download).
Login options.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Also list this organization's single sign-on provider.

403.description: local login disabled, or the organization requires single sign-on

get.summary: The signed-in user, the CSRF token and the user's organizations.

post.summary:
First start: creates the superuser and the first organization. Works
only while there are no users.

get.summary: What an invitation link is for. No authentication needed.

post.summary:
Accepts an invitation: as the signed-in user, or by creating an account
for the invited email (password login must be enabled).

get.summary: One issue, with 24 hours of statistics.

delete.summary: Deletes an issue and its events.

get.summary: Activity and comments of an issue, newest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `next_cursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: Attachments of an issue's events.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `next_cursor` of the previous page.

delete.summary: Deletes a comment (one's own; admins may delete any).

get.summary: Events of an issue, newest first.

The full normalized event (see the event shape in docs/api.md) plus
`previous_event_id` and `next_event_id`.
User feedback attached to an issue.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `next_cursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: Events and users of an issue over time.
Tag distributions of an issue's events (first-class attributes and tags).
All values of one tag, most frequent first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `next_cursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: Organizations of the caller (all of them for superusers).

post.summary:
Creates an organization; the caller becomes its owner. Needs a session
or a user token with `org:admin`.

get.summary: An organization.

delete.summary: Deletes an organization with all its projects and data. Owners only.

patch.summary: Renames an organization or changes its slug.

get.summary:
The organization's audit log, newest first. Includes the logins,
logouts and failed logins of its members.
Notification channels of an organization.

delete.summary: Deletes a channel. Alert rules that use it skip it from then on.

post.summary: Sends a test notification through a channel.

get.summary: A minimal event query: filtered rows or counts grouped by one column.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated columns to return; ignored with `group_by`.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Column to group by; the result has `count` per value.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Time range back from now (default 24h, at most 90d).

get.summary: An event by project and id.
Pending invitations.
Issues matching a search, with per-issue statistics.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: project ids, comma-separated or repeated; default all

parameters.name: period
parameters.description:
Only issues seen within this period (e.g. `24h`, `14d`); also the
range of `stats` (default 24h).

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Only issues with events in this environment.

put.summary: Bulk change of the issues given as `?id=..&id=..` (at most 100).

delete.summary: Deletes the issues given as `?id=..` with their events.

get.summary: Members of an organization, ordered by email.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `next_cursor` of the previous page.

post.summary: Invites someone by email. The invitation link is valid for 7 days.

delete.summary:
Removes a member (or leaves, when it is the caller). The last owner
cannot be removed.

patch.summary:
Changes a member's role. Admins cannot touch owners; the last owner
cannot be demoted.

get.summary: Projects of an organization.

post.summary: Creates a project with one client key.

get.summary: Releases of the organization, newest first.
A release with deploys, per-project health and daily sessions.
Saved searches: the caller's own and the organization's shared ones.
The organization's single sign-on configuration (404 if none).

put.summary:
Creates or replaces the single sign-on configuration. The issuer's
discovery document is fetched to check the settings. Owners only.

delete.summary: Removes the single sign-on configuration. Linked identities are kept.

get.summary: Teams of an organization with their members.

delete.summary: Deletes a team. Issues assigned to it become unassigned.

put.summary: Adds a member of the organization to a team.

get.summary: Organization tokens (for CI and the upload CLI).

post.summary:
Creates an organization token. It acts in this organization only, with
at most the admin role.

get.summary: A project.

delete.summary: Deletes a project and all its data.

patch.summary: Changes a project: name, slug, platform, team, settings.

get.summary: Alert rules of a project.
An alert rule.
User feedback of a project.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `next_cursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: Session health of a project over a period.
Client keys (DSNs) of a project.

delete.summary: Deletes a client key; SDKs using it are refused from then on.

patch.summary: Changes a client key (label, active, rate limit).

get.summary: Monitors of a project.

post.summary:
Creates a monitor. SDKs can also create monitors with check-ins that
carry a monitor configuration (handled by ingestion).

get.summary: A monitor with its latest 50 check-ins.

delete.summary: Deletes a monitor and its check-ins.

get.summary: Check-ins of a monitor, newest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `next_cursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: Accepted or rejected items over time, from the outcomes table.

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description:
`received` (accepted errors), `rejected` (filtered, rate limited,
invalid, discarded) or `filtered`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Start: Unix seconds or RFC 3339 (default: 24 hours ago).

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: End: Unix seconds or RFC 3339 (default: now).

get.summary: Every token scope.
The signed-in user.

patch.summary:
Changes name, avatar or password. A password change ends all other
sessions of the user.

get.summary: The caller's personal tokens.

post.summary: Creates a personal token. It acts as the user, limited by its scopes.

get.summary: Completes single sign-on and redirects into the app.
Redirects to the provider.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Local path to open after signing in.

name.description: For a new account: name and password.

conditions.description:
Any of: `{type: first_seen}`, `{type: regression}`,
`{type: reappeared}`, `{type: event_frequency, count, interval}`,
`{type: user_frequency, count, interval}` (interval like `1h`).

filters.description:
All of: `{type: level, level, match: eq|gte}`,
`{type: environment, value}`, `{type: tag, key, value}`.

frequency_minutes.description: At most one notification per issue and rule in this many minutes.

environment.description: Only events of this environment (empty string: any).

download_url.description: API path to download the file.

local_login.description: Email and password login is available.

setup_required.description: No user exists yet: the setup form should be shown.

sso.description: Single sign-on providers to offer as login buttons.

config.description:
email: `{to: [..]}`; slack and teams: `{webhook_url}`; webhook:
`{url, has_secret}` (the secret is write-only).

email: `{to: ["a@b.c"]}`; slack and teams: `{webhook_url}`;
webhook: `{url, secret?}`.

slug.description: Derived from the name if omitted.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the token expires; none = never.

ErrorBody.description: The error body, for the OpenAPI document.

adoption.description:
Share (percent) of the projects' sessions in the last 24 hours
that used this release.

crash_free_sessions.description: Percent of sessions that did not crash; `null` without sessions.

crash_free_users.description: Always `null`: session counts are not kept per user.

accept_url.description:
The acceptance link; returned only when it was just created, so an
admin can pass it on when email is not configured.

email_sent.description: Whether the invitation email was sent (needs SMTP).

user_exists.description:
An account with this email exists (log in to accept), otherwise
one can be created when accepting (if password login is enabled).

permalink.description: Link to the issue in the web app.

IssueUpdate.description: Changes to one or more issues.

ignore_count.description: With `status: ignored`: further events until it reappears.

ignore_duration.description: With `status: ignored`: minutes until the issue reappears.

resolved_in_release.description: With `status: resolved`: the release that fixes it.

rate_limit_per_min.description: Events per minute for this key; `null` = unlimited.

sso_linked.description: Signed in with single sign-on at least once.

checkin_margin.description: Minutes a check-in may be late.

next_cursor.description: Cursor of the next page; `null` on the last page.

download_url.description: API path to download the file.

short_version.description:
The version without a `package@` prefix, shortened if it is a
commit hash.

next_cursor.description: Cursor of the next page; `null` on the last page.
Cursor of the next page; `null` on the last page.

dsn.description: DSN of the first active key, for quick setup.

releases.description:
Releases with sessions in the period, most sessions first; `adoption`
is the share of the period's sessions.

client_secret.description: Omit to keep the stored secret; empty string for a public client.

short_version.description:
The version without a `package@` prefix, shortened if it is a
commit hash.

sessions.description: Daily `[[unix_seconds, sessions, crashed]]` of the last 14 days.

shared.description: Visible to the whole organization (otherwise only to its creator).

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on mutating requests; `null` for token auth.

enforce.description: Members must use single sign-on; password login is refused.

owner_local_login.description: With `enforce`, owners may still use their password (break-glass).

settings.description:
Partial settings: given top-level keys replace the stored ones;
`filters` and `scrubbing` are merged key by key.

team.description: Team slug; empty string removes the team.

current_password.description: To change the password, give the current and the new one.
